anomalies.observed: On the EthernetAndPower sheet the DC barrel jack J4 is wired with pin 1 tied to GND, pin 2 tied to BAT+, and pin 3 tied to BAT-. The sheet's own text note reads '2 and 3 are shorted with no plug / 1 is center, center is positive', i.e. pin 1 is the positive center pin, yet it is connected to GND and the sleeve (pin 2) to the positive rail.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the intended netlist is 'J4.1→BAT+ (center/positive), J4.2→GND (sleeve), J4.3→BAT-', so the center/positive pin 1 must drive BAT+ and the sleeve pin 2 must be GND. Pins 1 and 2 are swapped in this drawing.

evidence.quote: EthernetAndPower.kicad_sch: J4 'Barrel Jack Switch' note '2 and 3 are shorted with no plug / 1 is center, center is positive'; drawn wires: J4.1→GND, J4.2→BAT+, J4.3→BAT-
Netlist: J4.1→BAT+ (center/positive), J4.2→GND (sleeve), J4.3→BAT- ... inserting a DC plug breaks that short — disconnecting the battery
a1d9676 "Meshinger 1.0 rev B WARNING THE DC PLUG PINS ARE WRONG, SHORTS BATTERY!"

anomalies.impact: Because pins 2 and 3 are internally shorted when no plug is inserted, this wiring ties BAT+ straight to BAT-, dead-shortening the 18650 cell and the regulator input (exactly the 'SHORTS BATTERY' condition the commit log warns about). When a plug is inserted, the adapter's positive center pin (1) is tied to GND, shorting the supply. The automatic battery-disconnect feature does not work as intended.

parsed.summary: The drawing's barrel-jack J4 has pins 1 and 2 swapped relative to the intended design (and relative to the schematic's own 'center is positive' note), so with no plug inserted the internal 2-3 short bridges BAT+ to BAT-, shorting the battery — the documented rev-B bug rather than the intended rev-D wiring. Other traced interfaces (EPD signal mapping, FAN53610 regulator, Q2 display power switch, keyboard/SD/Ethernet labels) are consistent with the specification.
